display_name: 源训练插值与自由运行路径的误差诊断
description: 仅在固定源训练 L_s/U_s/G10 上分析 E20 含 clean 的训练插值点与自由轨迹噪声敏感度，不读取 TX、V/OE 或目标 IQ。

data.representation: Fixed first 128 original source R07 L_s, 128 U_s, 128 G10 L_s matched by exact physical ID, and the same 128 L_s clean; G10/R07 records may overlap, not new observations

permissions.regime: Frozen E20 and original Phase3 F0 on legal source training IQ only; no update, no label
permissions.claim_scope: Source training interpolation uses paired clean as an oracle and cannot be used at deployment; diagnostic tests hypotheses only, no target selection or accuracy claim.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen E20 flow and original frozen F0; no new optimizer
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact E20 checkpoint commit/epoch/updates/roles and F0 original role IDs; G10/source L_s physical IDs matched
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: E20 F0-guided source model fixed, no heldout or target training; F0 retains supervised source knowledge
checkpoint.selection_rule: Report all fixed time points and all fixed noise scales for first 128 records per group; no target or V data and no parameter updates.

metric_names: free-run IQ NMSE and opposite-path difference

rows.method: Frozen original E20 velocity on clean-fed interpolation vs four-step received-started trajectories
rows.seed_notes: Fixed 2026110103 noise template, exact existing paired observations, deterministic time grid and noise scale list
rows.scenario: Fixed 128 per original source group; clean-fed interpolation is an offline oracle

notes: Trigger is source-train path diagnostic: E20 four-step G10 L_s mean NMSE 0.9289 and output difference of antithetic paths greatly exceeds the difference at start.

Training interpolation explicitly contains paired source clean, so it is an oracle diagnostic and never a deployable input. Contrast losses along those fixed points with free trajectories and noise perturbation.
All inputs are fixed 128 L_s/U_s source groups and F0 is frozen. Zero TX/V/OE/target IQ/optimizer. E30 rollout already launched based on source path diagnosis, never altered by this diagnostic.
Two targeted formula/antithetic tests and independent P0/P1 review passed; source role IDs and G10 IDs matched, real F0/E20 smoke before full groups.
Existing rollout is already admitted on GPU4 and will not reacquire GPU; forcing controller includes its worker token and must select another available GPU without touching it.
